cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(giflib LANGUAGES C)

add_library(giflib STATIC
    dgif_lib.c
    egif_lib.c
    gifalloc.c
    gif_err.c
    gif_font.c
    gif_hash.c
    openbsd-reallocarray.c
    quantize.c
)

target_include_directories(giflib SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(giflib PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(giflib PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4267 /wd4996)
endif()
